common:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished high-fidelity desktop application screen, full-bleed front-on screenshot, 16:10 landscape, high resolution, crisp readable Simplified Chinese UI. This is an alternative layout for an existing professional AI photorealistic drama studio workbench called 片场. Not a marketing landing page, not an infographic, no laptop/device frame, no presentation annotations.
REFERENCE IMAGE 1 is ONLY the cinematic media source: reuse the same Chinese woman in beige-gray trench coat and cream knitwear, Chinese man in dark coat, rainy cafe, and old brass key. The six panels are six shots, not a single image to paste wholesale. The selected shot SH04 is the bottom-left hand taking a brass key; show a natural realistic close-up from this panel.
REFERENCE IMAGE 2 is ONLY a visual system reference: keep neutral dark gray #141414 / #1B1B1B / #242424, text #EAEAEA / #B8B8B8, restrained warm apricot #EDB878 accent, thin gray borders, low shadows, Mantine-like simple flat controls with 6px radius, Chinese system sans font, outline icons. Do NOT copy its dense layout. Refine the hierarchy and reduce administrative chrome. No purple, neon, glossy gradients, oversized rounded cards or excessive badges.
COMMON TASK AND STATE FOR ALL VARIANTS: project 旧钥匙, episode 第1集, scene 咖啡厅, current shot SH04 拿起旧钥匙. The user is handling this review note: “拿钥匙的接触点再自然一些”. Looking at candidate B; candidate A remains adopted and used in the cut. Show short contextual “正在查看 B” and “当前采用 A” only near the relevant result, never mark B as adopted. Exactly two candidates A and B, with plausible minor hand-motion variation; no different color grading between candidates. This is preparation for another attempt, with one primary button “准备生成”. Use the same scene and image content in every alternative.
COMMON GLOBAL SHELL: a very slim 56px far-left app rail with a tiny warm clapper logo and four quiet icons, one selected; no expanded admin sidebar, no tasks or budget dashboards. One shallow top header: “旧钥匙 / 第1集 / 咖啡厅”, small stage navigation “制作  剪辑  审阅” with 制作 active, quiet “预览整场” action at right. The rest is creative workspace. One compact strip of six scene-shot thumbnails at the bottom, labeled SH01 through SH06, SH04 selected. Minimal metadata: image, shot number, short name only. Do not repeat actor ownership, approval, cut status on every card. Avoid many stacked header bands. Make actual cinematic content dominate, with comfortable readable controls and deliberate negative space.
TEXT TO USE WHERE RELEVANT: “SH04 拿起旧钥匙”; “本次修改”; “拿钥匙的接触点再自然一些”; “参考”; “林夏”; “咖啡厅”; “旧钥匙”; “手部近景。先接触钥匙，再握住抬起，保持人物与节奏。”; “Seedance”; “9:16”; “更多参数”; “准备生成”; “候选 A”; “候选 B”; “镜头要求”; “历史”; “全场分镜”.
All images must be real photographic cinema stills using the supplied media references, no gray placeholder boxes. Use full 9:16 framing in the main viewer; small navigation thumbnails may crop deliberately. Maintain distinct image vs UI surfaces. Be realistic enough to review the working space at normal desktop size. Keep short exact Chinese text instead of adding unreadable invented paragraphs.

variants.focus:
LAYOUT 01 — FOCUSED SHOT PRODUCTION. This is the calm recommended baseline and must feel significantly simpler than reference image 2. The main workspace is split into a very large media stage (roughly 72%) and a compact 320px right creation panel (28%). No scene overview grid and no left shot list; the bottom six-shot strip provides scene navigation.
Media stage: one quiet heading SH04 拿起旧钥匙 with a small “镜头要求” reveal link, a restrained selected-media toolbar with only “继续生成”, “局部调整”, “…” near the image. A tall dominant portrait close-up of the hand and brass key centered on a neutral dark stage, with simple playback chrome. Below it just TWO compact candidate thumbnails side by side A and B, B with a thin amber selection border and A with small text “当前采用”. No large bordered boxes around the entire stage.
Right panel: title 本次修改, a single-line review note, three small reference thumbnails in one row (woman, cafe, key), a visible prompt input containing the exact short prompt, one compact row “Seedance  ·  9:16” plus “更多参数”, and one warm primary “准备生成” button. No tabs inside the panel, no stacks of independent cards, no chat column. References and prompt visible together, comfortably sized. Bottom scene strip short, clean and clearly separate from candidates. The goal is immediate recognition of current image and next action.
variants.overview:
LAYOUT 02 — LIGHT SCENE OVERVIEW WITH CONTEXTUAL EDITING. Distinct from layout 01: the dominant workspace is a calm gallery of the six shot thumbnails, 3 columns by 2 rows, with generous media area. Global shell and bottom shot strip stay subtle; to avoid duplicated navigation the bottom strip is REPLACED in this variant by one thin quiet “6 个镜头 · 46 秒” footer, not another thumbnail strip. Keep the six ordered story images consistent with the supplied reference: two people at table; woman questioning; man hesitant; hand taking key; woman remembering; two-shot reaction.
Each gallery tile has ONLY a clean 4:3 cinematic crop and one compact label row such as SH04 拿起旧钥匙. No paragraph descriptions, no owner badges, no repeated adoption and editing states. SH04 has a thin amber outline and a small two-candidate indicator; all others neutral. A small “全场分镜” gallery heading and “添加镜头” subtle action.
At right use one 320px contextual creation panel for SH04, showing its title, a small complete portrait preview of the hand/key (not another giant picture), concise current review note, three reference thumbnails, compact prompt editor, “Seedance · 9:16” row, one primary 准备生成 button. A small inline “查看候选 2” action opens alternatives conceptually; do not render another tab bar. Keep the layout clean and production oriented; this is not a project-management dashboard. The difference from layout 01 should be immediately apparent: whole-scene spatial coverage vs focused large single-shot viewing.
variants.chat:
LAYOUT 03 — MEDIA CANVAS WITH CHAT AND DIRECT EDITING. This must visually read as an actual spatial creation canvas, not a storyboard grid, flowchart, or stack of form cards. Keep same slim rail/header and same bottom six-shot scene strip, but this strip occupies only the canvas width, not under the chat.
Rightmost 340px is a clean collapsible Chat panel titled “创作助手”. Top of chat shows a tiny context chip “SH04 · 候选 B”. One short user message: “让拿钥匙的动作更自然，保留人物和节奏。” One concise assistant reply: “建议先触碰，再握住抬起。已保留人物、机位与参考。” Then an understated object link “查看修改方案 ↗”. No long conversation wall, no skill marketplace tiles. Chat composer fixed near panel bottom with “继续描述要求…” and small send icon. Do not put the paid generation CTA in chat.
The large central/left area is a dark spacious dot-grid canvas. Show 3–4 floating media objects at different spatial positions and sizes, with generous visible canvas around them. At left a compact grouped pair of reference media (woman and cafe), with small unobtrusive labels. In the middle one dominant selected image node containing the full portrait hand/key close-up, title “SH04 · 候选 B” above it. Slightly upper-right within canvas a smaller earlier candidate A thumbnail with quiet text “当前采用”. Use only two subtle curved dependency lines, no giant flowchart boxes or mandatory giant SH04 container around everything.
Just ABOVE the selected media node a compact contextual toolbar “继续生成  局部调整  更多”. Just BELOW it a compact floating input panel directly attached visually: small reference thumbnail chips; two-line exact prompt; footer “Seedance · 9:16” and ONE warm primary “准备生成”. This local prompt panel is clearly different from the global right Chat. Hide the persistent properties inspector entirely. Main selected media remains big; do not let the prompt cover the photo or overlap the bottom sequence. Keep all elements fully in view in one screen. This alternative demonstrates working directly on media while optionally asking an assistant, preserving independent scene order.
